3. If insurance had been purchased, we would see an additional payment of $60 ($30 per passenger for 2 passengers) in the payment history

While I understand you remember purchasing insurance, the system records are clear and definitive on this matter. I am not able to check insurance status in any other way, as all reservation details, including insurance status, are contained within the reservation record I've already checked.

Given the sensitivity of this situation and your strong recollection that differs from what the system shows, I believe it would be best to transfer you to a human agent who can:
1. Do a more detailed investigation of your booking history
2. Access additional systems that might not be available to me
3. Better discuss your options in this situation
